items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1957-03-21
items.q: And after Freddie comes, uh, little René Kid René. And a little favorite player also.

ctx.x: Was he the best in his time, would you say that, or what?
Well, in that kind of jazz band, he was a little favorite of that time. He was. And after Freddie comes, uh, little René Kid René. And a little favorite player also. Them was fellas with high tones.
